items.title: Solana's Supply Squeeze Vote
points: SOL token reclaimed $105 for first time since January, tracking 44% monthly gains heading into binding governance votes on token supply cuts
SIMD-550 would double yearly disinflation rate (the pace at which new token issuance shrinks over time) from 15% to 30%
SIMD-553 would split transaction fees into a validator-paid 'inclusion fee' and a destroyed 'resource fee,' ramping daily SOL burn from ~650 to as much as 9,000 tokens
Prediction market sentiment flipped from 70% bearish at month start to 50-50 odds on whether SOL reaches $160 or drops to $40, signaling traders are pricing in a supply squeeze before the vote closes

items.title: Bitcoin and ETF Momentum
points: Bitcoin ETFs posted $2.8 billion in inflows over an eight-day streak as BTC tested the $80,000 price level
August is tracking its strongest monthly inflow pace since October 2025 if current momentum holds, per analyst assessments
Six Bitcoin wallets dormant for over a decade simultaneously reactivated between August 16-26, moving tens of millions of dollars in BTC (about $40M) during the single week

items.title: Regulatory and Infrastructure Moves
points: BankChain Alliance launched by US banks to give smaller financial institutions access to tokenized deposits (digital representations of bank deposits on a blockchain) and crypto payments through a unified network

Bank of England received a new statutory duty to promote stablecoin innovation (stablecoins are cryptocurrencies pegged to a stable asset like the US dollar), with the authorizing bill set for House of Lords review in September; financial stability remains the bank's primary objective

items.title: Security and AI Concerns
points: OpenAI banned ChatGPT accounts assessed as originating from Russia that were generating academic-impersonating social media posts as part of a coordinated influence network
GrapheneOS user Samuel Tunick faces a five-year prosecution over a wiped phone and claims he was secretly placed on a terrorist watch list without disclosure
